♡ sealed with love ♡

Dear my love,

Happy birthday, my favourite person. I wish I could be right beside you today — holding your hand, looking at your smile, and making this day feel as special as you are. I know miles separate us right now, but they could never make my love smaller. Thank you for being my comfort, my happiness, and my favourite hello. I hope this year brings you every beautiful thing your heart has been waiting for. And whenever life feels heavy, I hope you remember that you mattered to me in ways words can never fully explain. You will always remain one of my favourite people, and I will always be grateful for the memories we made.

with warmth, and a heart full of memories ♡
before you leave...

one last thing, from my heart ♡

You will remain my favourite person.

I was going to write, “Hum forever saath rahenge”… but ab aisa nahi hai. Kuch rishton mein naa milna bhi zaroori hai. Phir bhi, jo khoobsurat yaadein hain, unki jagah hamesha rahegi. I genuinely wish you happiness, peace, and all the beautiful things life has to offer. Happy Birthday. ♡

take care, always ∞
